items.title: Notice of Intent To Prepare an Environmental Impact Statement for Training and Exercises at Airfields in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands

data.abstract: The Department of the Air Force (DAF) is issuing this Notice of Intent (NOI) to prepare an Environmental Impact Statement (EIS) to assess the potential social, economic, and environmental effects associated with conducting aircraft training and exercises at airfields in the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands (CNMI), including Saipan International Airport, Tinian International Airport, Tinian North Field, and Rota International Airport. DAF is the lead agency for the CNMI Airfields Training and Exercises (CATE) EIS and intends to invite the Federal Aviation Administration and Commonwealth Ports Authority to be cooperating agencies. DAF will consult with, and obtain the comments of, federal agencies that have jurisdiction by law or special expertise related to the environmental analysis.

items.title: Recertification of Prince William Sound Regional Citizens' Advisory Council

data.abstract: The Coast Guard announces the recertification of the Prince William Sound Regional Citizen's Advisory Council (PWSRCAC) as an alternative voluntary advisory group for Prince William Sound, Alaska for a period of March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. Under the Oil Pollution Act of 1990 (OPA 90), the Coast Guard may recertify the PWSRCAC on an annual basis. This certification allows PWSRCAC to monitor the activities of terminal facilities and crude oil tankers under an alternative composition as established by OPA 90 statute.

items.title: Special Local Regulation; Port Miami Main Shipping Channel, Miami FL

data.abstract: The Coast Guard is proposing to establish a temporary special local regulation (SLR) for certain navigable waters of the Miami Shipping Channel offshore of Port Miami, Miami, FL in connection with the E1 Miami Grand Prix. The SLR is needed to protect personnel, vessels, and the marine environment from potential hazards created by high-speed powerboat racing. This proposed rulemaking would prohibit persons and vessels from being in or loitering around the regulated area unless specifically authorized by the Captain of the Port, Sector Miami. We invite your comments on this proposed rulemaking.

items.title: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Collection; Comment Request; Food and Drug Administration Rapid Response Surveys

data.abstract: The Food and Drug Administration (FDA or Agency) is announcing an opportunity for public comment on the proposed collection of certain information by the Agency. Under the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995 (PRA), Federal Agencies are required to publish notice in the Federal Register concerning each proposed collection of information, including each proposed extension of an existing collection of information, and to allow 60 days for public comment in response to the notice. This notice solicits comments on the use of rapid response surveys to obtain data on safety information that supports quick turnaround decision making about potential safety problems or risk management solutions.
